formulas.formula: Calm, simple, considered. Everything you need, nothing you don't.
1. Setup: your name and the year.
2. Budget: one number per category, per month.
3. Transactions: income and spending. Pick a category.
4. Year at a Glance: every category, every month, on one page.
5. Sinking Funds and Net Worth: what you're setting aside and what you own.
A few clear categories beat dozens. Merge anything you rarely use.
Divide each yearly cost by 12 and set it aside monthly.
Log transfers to savings with the Savings category. They count as saved, not spent.
Ten minutes at month end. Adjust one thing.
Clear the white cells on Budget, Transactions, Sinking Funds and Net Worth.
Tinted cells: these calculate for you.
Clay: over plan, or something to check.
Planned income and spending per month. Actual comes from Transactions.
Income and spending. Pick a category.
Every category, every month. Shaded = more than the monthly plan.
Income, spending and savings by month.
What you own and owe. Update monthly or quarterly.
